div.span: Order rationale: the decision chain (M1) is the core of zero trust and everything else feeds it signals (M2), makes it available (M3), deploys it (M4), hardens it (M5) or measures it (M6). Security work that needs no code (threat model, zone model) is pulled forward to match the TEK5520 lectures.
